## Summary

Tumanza is an online store for organic dry fruits, nuts, herbs and teas. The business is based in Islamabad, Pakistan, with product roots tied to highland organic farming (including Gilgit-Baltistan sourcing). Products are sold in PKR with delivery across Pakistan.

## Key pages

- /shop — full product catalog
- /product/{slug} — individual product pages with price, stock and reviews
- /about — brand origin story
- /contact — NAP and enquiry form
